qemu.boundary: QEMU A/R-profile system emulation, not physical ARM or Intel HVF. MVFR2 is undefined on the selected pre-v8 CPUs; the zero output is an initialized sentinel when mvfr2_undefined is 1.

remaining_scope: All four complete original findings remain incomplete.
Prepared-context coordinator continuation does not implement guest AP firmware/startup.
Current native ESR/FAR, pending reply and timer capture defects are separately reproduced and still require implementation.
Physical Intel HVF validation remains unavailable; cross-checks are compilation only.

assumption_register.assumption: The represented MVFR fields select instruction capability, rather than being unrelated writable descriptive values.
assumption_register.basis: Existing half/FHM admission uses MVFR1 and ID_ISAR6; MVFR2/FP subfeature admission must be traced from primary definitions and supported profile construction.
assumption_register.stress_test: Consistent VFPv3/VFPv4/enhanced profiles, full-profile positive controls and reserved values.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Primary rules or accepted runtime constructors select capabilities independently of these fields.
assumption_register.status: confirmed for represented MVFR1/MVFR2 instruction families by primary field definitions, direct pre-fix failures, enabled controls and independent observations

assumption_register.assumption: Production ARM/Thumb/mixed execution should suppress failed predicates before capability faults.
assumption_register.basis: Existing shared executor and half/FHM contracts.
assumption_register.stress_test: ARM conditions, legal Thumb IT forms, disabled access and zero-retirement backend execution.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Independent architecture/QEMU cases fault on a legitimately skipped instruction.
assumption_register.status: confirmed for tested ARM scalar and legal Thumb IT forms by direct controls and 48 independent QEMU skipped-instruction observations

assumption_register.assumption: Defined intermediate MVFR2 levels and contradictory ID combinations represent valid physical Armv8-A profiles.
assumption_register.basis: Potential interpretation of a bare capability-field boundary matrix.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Physical-profile claims from synthetic field tests.
assumption_register.stress_test: Read the permitted-values constraints and compare actual model feature reads.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Armv8-A restricts FPMisc to 0/4 and SIMDMisc to 0/3.
assumption_register.status: falsified; intermediate/reserved/contradictory field tests are software admission-policy tests only

assumption_register.assumption: Creating two/four vCPUs makes all of them online for the new file-continuation fixture.
assumption_register.basis: The prior fixture executed each CPU directly instead of going through coordinator selection.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Expected per-CPU turns in the new coordinator continuation test.
assumption_register.stress_test: Inspect ExecutionCoordinator::new and next; retain actual failed file tests.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: online starts as [true,false,...], so a subsequent turn selects halted CPU0 again.
assumption_register.status: falsified by current constructor/selection source and retained file-test failures; explicitly activate configured contexts in the software fixture, leaving architectural AP startup open

assumption_register.assumption: Connecting the existing raw S3C step to the bounded vCPU contract preserves the legacy heartbeat during continuous execution.
assumption_register.basis: Heartbeat had previously been polled at legacy run() batch boundaries.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Compatibility of diagnostics and RAX_DUMP_PHYS under coordinator stepping.
assumption_register.stress_test: Force a due heartbeat, execute a NOP through step_insn, and compare complete backend state with a fresh control.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The due timestamp is unchanged after a successful Progress step.
assumption_register.status: falsified for the previous stepping path; corrected by invoking the existing heartbeat on Progress. Eight complete S3C platform regressions pass, including due/fresh full backend equality.

validation_evidence.status: Final recorded gates passed within the stated host/software and source-equivalence boundaries.
